statement_pin_required.convention: Fix connected G : SimpleGraph V, Fintype V. Claim: if G ≠ ⊤ and G is not an odd cycle, then G.Colorable G.maxDegree. Odd cycle pin: Connected ∧ Odd (card V) ∧ ∀ v, degree v = 2. Complete pin: G = ⊤.
